title: 01. Clean notification emails

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your code in the function at the top of the editor. Follow the numbered steps and replace each TODO. Run checks the three examples. Submit checks all cases, including edge cases. Open the hints one at a time if you are stuck.

Keep the adapter class at the bottom unchanged. It reads the input, calls your function, and rejects changes to the input. Python 3.11 and the standard library.

starterCode.python:
def clean_emails(emails):
    """Return clean addresses, without duplicates, in first-seen order.

    clean_emails([' ADA@EXAMPLE.COM ', 'ada@example.com', 'bob@example.com'])
    -> ['ada@example.com', 'bob@example.com']
    """
    result = []    # the clean addresses, in order
    seen = set()   # the addresses that are already in result (fast lookup)

    for email in emails:
        # Step 1: clean the address.
        #         Remove whitespace at both ends, then make it lowercase.
        cleaned = email  # TODO

        # Step 2: skip it when it is empty or already in `seen`.
        #         `continue` goes to the next email.
        # TODO

        # Step 3: keep it.
        # TODO: add `cleaned` to `seen` and append it to `result`.

    return result


# Supplied CoJudge adapter. Implement clean_emails above.
class Solution:
    def run(self, payload: str) -> str:
        import json
        data = json.loads(payload)
        before = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)
        result = clean_emails(**data)
        if json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) != before:
            raise ValueError("Do not modify the input objects")
        return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False)

hints: Use two containers: a list keeps the order, and a set answers "do I already have it?" quickly.
`email.strip()` removes whitespace at both ends. `.lower()` changes the case. You can chain them: `email.strip().lower()`.
An empty string is falsy, so one check covers both skips: `if not cleaned or cleaned in seen: continue`.
